responsibility: This header defines `auto_obstack`, a tiny RAII wrapper around GCC’s obstack allocation facility for host-side temporary object construction. It owns initialization and full release of an embedded `obstack`, exposes implicit access to the underlying obstack plus common helpers such as `grow`, `object_base`, and `object_size`, and is used where code wants stack-scoped lifetime management for variable-sized buffered data built with obstack primitives rather than manual `obstack_init`/`obstack_free` calls.
